biotools.summary: cgDist is a software algorithm for efficient calculation of pairwise SNP and InDel differences from core genome multilocus sequence typing (cgMLST). It bridges the resolution gap between traditional cgMLST and SNP-based methods, enabling detailed genomic surveillance within computational constraints.
